items.rationale: The model has no memory between sessions; only text in the current context is visible. Option b treats the window as memory (M3); a and d assume memory that does not exist.

Call 1 reads 2,000. Call 2 re-sends the history plus the request and result: 2,000 + 50 + 500 = 2,550. Total 2,000 + 2,550 = 4,550. Answering 2,500 counts only the new tool result and request once, forgetting that every call re-sends the history.
Retrieval loads only a few small chunks, so each call stays small. Pasting the manual, even once into a bigger window, is re-sent and paid for at every call.
